races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: UNFLINCHING made his 2m hurdle debut in what turned out to be a very strong maiden at Limerick last Christmas and is taken to come good on return stepped up to a trip which is sure to suit. Henry de Bromhead's Midtown Manhattan should have more to offer now stepping back up in trip and is second choice ahead of the more-established Young Doran . UNFLINCHING (FR) MIDTOWN MANHATTAN (IRE) YOUNG DORAN (IRE)

races.title: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: ROKANAKO sets the standard among those with experience and may get off the mark under Michael Kenneally. Hurdling debutant Don't Hold Back is potentially interesting in a weak race, while S T Hamo faces a more realistic assignment than on his hurdling bow last week. races.title: Clonmel Oil Chase (Grade 2)
races.verdict: IL ETAIT TEMPS is now unbeaten in his last 7 completed starts, a wide-margin winner of this race last year before going on to success at both Cheltenham and Punchestown in the spring, and he is hard to oppose on his return. Stablemate Kappa Jy Pyke can be the one to give the selection most to think about, Willie Mullins having won the last 4 renewals of this Grade 2. IL ETAIT TEMPS (FR) KAPPA JY PYKE (FR) BLAZE THE WAY (IRE)

races.title: Prior Park Service Station Clonmel Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict: Sent off favourite returning over fences, ONEFORTHEDITCH was undone by an awkward landing 2 out when finishing mid-field at Galway a month ago, so she is well worth another chance off her significantly lower chase mark. She gets the vote ahead of Courtbrack Boy who made an encouraging chasing debut, while Stily could also be in the mix. ONEFORTHEDITCH (IRE) COURTBRACK BOY (IRE) STILY (FR)

races.title: racingtv.com/freetrial Flat Race
races.verdict: Gordon Elliott has taken this prize in 2 of the past 3 years and his Poet's Word gelding GREENBRIER , placed on his sole run in a point, is taken to add to the tally with last year's winning rider Harry Swan in the saddle again. Red Seagull rates the pick of those with experience and is next on the list ahead of River Cartwright and Distraction . GREENBRIER (IRE) RED SEAGULL (IRE) RIVER CARTWRIGHT (IRE)
